description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure AWS DynamoDB storage as grain storage in Orleans hosting environment.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to add DynamoDB grain storage configuration.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage as the default grain storage, with options configured via an Action.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage with a specified name and options configured via an Action.
